simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רָוֶה (H7302) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רָוֶה (râveh) means sated (with drink) First listed occurrence: Deut 29 18.

definitions.full: H7302. raveh רָוֶה adjective watered ; — masculine singular ׳ר , of garden גַּן (in simile) Jer 31:12 ; Isa 58:11 ; feminine singular הָרָוָה Deut 29:18 (opposed to הַצְּמֵאָה ; apparently of herbage, in proverb, expression for everything ); perhaps also construct רְוֵה Job 10:15 = sated with afflication (for רְאֵה ), see [ רָאֶה ].
